Emergency / Preparedness Apps to Install

Installing key apps before an emergency can make a big difference if cell networks fail, internet goes down, or you need to coordinate or navigate during a disaster.

Link
Communication
Signal - Private Messenger

Secure end-to-end encrypted messaging, voice, and video calls designed to keep communication private.

Link
Communication
Bitchat Mesh

Bluetooth mesh messaging that can relay messages through nearby phones without internet or cell service.

Link
Communication
Bridgefy - Offline Messages

Bluetooth-based messaging that works without internet, allowing communication with nearby devices.

Link
Communication
Zello Walkie Talkie

Push-to-talk walkie-talkie style voice communication for individuals and groups.

Link
Communication
Voxer Walkie Talkie Messenger

Voice messaging with push-to-talk functionality similar to a digital walkie-talkie.

Link
Navigation & Location
Guru Maps - Offline Navigation

Download maps in advance and navigate using GPS without internet access.

Link
Navigation & Location
OsmAnd Maps

Offline maps based on OpenStreetMap with navigation, routing, and downloadable regions.

Link
Navigation & Location
what3words

Divides the world into small grid squares with unique three-word addresses for precise location sharing.

Link
Medical & Emergency Help
First Aid - IFRC (Red Cross)

Step-by-step first aid instructions and emergency guidance that can be accessed offline.

Kiwix

Download Wikipedia and other reference libraries for offline access to information.
